haiku.problem: Jesus does not say why the crowd went to Capernaum. Verse 26 gives the reason they are seeking Him, that they ate the loaves and had their fill. The question should ask why Jesus says the crowd is looking for Him.

The statement in verse 29 is made on the other side of the sea, where the crowd found Jesus (verse 25), not in Capernaum. Capernaum is only where the synagogue teaching in verse 59 happened, so the question's setting is inaccurate.
